name: Ethnic-wear shoot
title: Ethnic-wear shoot — sarees, lehengas and suits on a model, in an Indian setting
summary: Sarees, lehengas, kurtis and suits worn by your model in a setting you choose: stills, then a short clip.
covers: Indian ethnic wear: sarees, lehengas, kurtis, salwar suits, anarkalis, sharara and palazzo sets, dupattas

shots.direction: The model wearing the garment in the chosen place, framed so the whole garment reads — full length or three-quarter, never cropped through the border or the hem. The drape, border, pallu or dupatta fall exactly as the product photos show them; every motif, colour and zari tone matches. She moves naturally — a step, a turn, the pallu lifting — and looks toward the camera.
